Model.Name: SchwingNet: vertebral level naming from one intraoperative C-arm exposure (detectors, level encoder, recurrent head, count from the sacrum, alphabet coupling)
Model.Summary: SchwingNet names the vertebral level of each body on one intraoperative C-arm exposure, with no preoperative scan, registration, tracked instrument or fiducial. Four parts ship together: (1) two detectors never trained on the test C-arm, a film-trained YOLO11m-pose keypoint detector that boxes the bodies to be named (confidence 0.35) and a YOLO11m vertebra/sacrum detector trained on real COBRA2026 and DeepFluoro frames that boxes the sacrum (confidence 0.74, set on three other devices); (2) a ResNet-18 level encoder reading a fixed-scale two-channel crop per body into a 512-d embedding and a 27-level posterior (C1-C7, T1-T13, L1-L6, sacrum); (3) a two-layer bidirectional GRU head over runs of two to nine bodies; (4) a count of each body's rank from the detected sacrum and an alphabet coupling that chooses the ordinary, L6, T13 or both-variant naming and stops the read when the classifier disagrees. On C-ArmLSpine (148 lumbar cases, one C-arm, cone-beam CT truth from two automatic labellers), never trained on that C-arm, it named 594 of 617 (96.3 %; Wilson on the design-effect-adjusted n 92.0-98.3; 141 cases) detected lateral vertebrae exactly and 239 of 631 anteroposterior; fine-tuned with case-grouped folds 606 of 617 (98.2 %) and with folds grouped by acquisition day 571 of 617 (92.5 %); with three bodies in view 1,079 of 1,162 (92.9 %). At detector confidence 0.74 the coupled call was exact on 995 of 1,009 anchored bodies (98.6 %). The held-out detector found 231 of 287 vertebrae (80.5 %; 74.1-86.8) and 43 of 56 sacra (76.8 %; 64.3-89.3). Transitional spines: 3 persons with a real transitional exposure exist in public releases, scored only in cross-validation as agreement with one labeller's read; no held-out transitional person is scored, and the comparison with registration-assisted labelling (LevelCheck) and surgeons using it is a separate study (paper 2, SchwingNet/paper2_levelcheck/). Research prototype; nothing evaluated prospectively; not for clinical use.

Descriptors.Ethical review: No new patient data were acquired. The Wayne State University IRB Administration Office issued a Notice of IRB Administrative Determination on 2026-09-02 (WSU IRB HPR Number 2026-269, 'Open Spine Consortium: Secondary Analysis of Publicly Available, De-Identified Imaging Datasets and the Derived Annotations, Software, and Models Produced From Them'): not human participant research under 45 CFR 46 or FDA regulations; IRB review not required (the signed notice was read page by page on 2026-09-23). The determination covers sources that are public, de-identified before release and downloadable without application or data use agreement. VinDr-SpineXR, whose films sit in the intraoperative fold banks, is released by PhysioNet only under its Restricted Health Data Use Agreement and is outside that scope; a separate determination, or retraining without it, is open before submission. One C-ArmLSpine directory (case134/ori, 302 XA frames) carries a real PatientID and name; it is excluded from every bank and never printed.

Descriptors.Version: Level models: the C-ArmLSpine case-grouped five-fold arm scored 2026-09-21 (docs/carmlspine_cv5_mixed_2026-09-21.json, re-scored with intervals in SchwingNet/results/a4.json), the day-grouped arm (results/a9.json) and the zero-shot arm (results/a7.json); the embedding is of allspine_v9 (SHA-256 188f9fcbfa3c6de1..., results/figure2/figure2_metrics.json). Detectors: rx_lodo_carmlspine_1024 (results/a1.json) and the keypoint detector detector_v5z_final (docs/MANIFEST_DATA_MODELS_RESULTS.md). The split-trained arm (encoder from ImageNet weights on the training side of the built person-disjoint split, because the v8/v9 level banks trained on 49 of the 54 L6 validation and test persons; docs/RESUME_2026-09-22_PM.md, checkpoint 2026-09-23 21:45; tables/tab4_transitional.md note d) is scored in paper 2 (SchwingNet/paper2_levelcheck/), whose manifest fixes bank, split, initialisation and recipe before unblinding; the manuscript shows only its development learning curve (supplement) and scores no held-out transitional person (SchwingNet/PAPER1_SCOPE.md). No code SHA is recorded in the level-model result files (docs/MODEL_CARD.md 1.2). Checkpoint lineage for 306 checkpoints, from each result file back to the public release weights: SchwingNet/results/eval_gate/LINEAGE.md.

Model properties.Architecture: Body detector: YOLO11m-pose (Ultralytics) fine-tuned for 60 epochs on the plain-film keypoint corpus from the pose checkpoint detect_v3, itself trained from the COCO-pretrained yolo11m-pose.pt (docs/MANIFEST_DATA_MODELS_RESULTS.md, detector_v5z_final; results/eval_gate/LINEAGE.md); confidence 0.35. Sacrum detector: YOLO11m, classes vertebra and sacrum, 1,024-pixel input, initialised from COCO-pretrained yolo11m.pt through the render-trained anchor_none_v2_17-1882, 80 epochs, patience 25, batch 8, seed 0, deterministic; augmentation degrees 10, translate 0.1, scale 0.3, fliplr 0.5, mosaic 0.5 (args.yaml and data.yaml of rx_lodo_carmlspine_1024, read on the grid 2026-09-22); its best.pt was selected on the COBRA2026 and DeepFluoro test splits (results/eval_gate/EVALUATORS.md item 2); confidence 0.74 (results/a1.json cross_device_0.74 how_chosen). Level encoder: ResNet-18 with a two-channel stem (image + target marker) over a 2 x 320 x 320 fixed-scale crop with the target body at 96 pixels, 27-class head, 11,173,376 parameters, 3.62 GMAC per crop; the cross-validation encoders are initialised from registry alias allspine_v2_r1 and fine-tuned per fold for 15 epochs at lr 1e-4 with AdamW, cosine schedule and class-weighted cross-entropy (slurm/carmlspine_cv.sh; tools/train_level_classifier.py); horizontal-flip test-time averaging. Recurrent head: Linear(512->256) + GELU, two-layer bidirectional GRU(256), Linear(512->27), 2,117,403 parameters, trained on mixed-length runs of 2-9 bodies (tools/head_mixed_length.py --train-mode mixed: 30 epochs, lr 1e-3, AdamW, cosine). Count: rank from the detected sacrum, no morphology. Alphabet coupling (tools/alphabet_couple.py): chooses among the ordinary, L6, T13 and both-variant alphabets the one best fitting the posteriors at the ordinals; a classifier name differing from the call stops the read. No learned parameters in the count or the coupling. The sweep linker of earlier drafts is not part of the reported system.
Model properties.Availability: Not public. Weights on the Wayne State grid: fold encoders ~/carm_cvmix{0..4}_fov96_ctx/runs/model_rung_1_ft_cv{k}_aug2.pt, heads ~/model_night/heads_carm/head_cv{0..4}.pt, sacrum detector ~/spine-detector/runs/realxray/rx_lodo_carmlspine_1024/weights/best.pt, body detector ~/FluoroCap/detect_v5z_final_best.pt (registered, docs/MANIFEST_DATA_MODELS_RESULTS.md). The fold encoders, heads and sacrum detector carry no registered SHA-256 (docs/MODEL_CARD.md 1.3), a defect to repair before any deposit. Available to reviewers and editors on request; what is released at publication is the author's open decision (License).
Model properties.Clinical benefit: None demonstrated. No prospective or clinical study exists and no clinician has read the output in theatre. The motivating harm is wrong-level spine surgery; no naming accuracy here is a wrong-level surgery rate.
Model properties.Clinical workflow phase: Intraoperative (during localisation on a C-arm), as a research prototype only. Not in any clinical workflow.
Model properties.Decision threshold: Sacrum detector confidence 0.74: the best pooled vertebra F1 of this arm over its sweeps on COBRA2026, DeepFluoro and the Geneva phantom, reading no C-ArmLSpine frame; adopted as the headline after the 0.25 result had been reported, so it is described as cross-device, not pre-stated (results/a1.json). Body detector confidence 0.35. Naming abstains when the decoded and single-crop names disagree or the top posterior is below 0.5, an untuned default on an uncalibrated posterior; lateral whole frame, case-grouped: 513 of 617 answered, 505 of 513 exact (results/a7.json cv5/det/LAT/kfull default_rule). The coupled call's stop signal: count from the detected sacrum exact on 979 of 1,009 anchored bodies of 130 cases (97.0 %; 94.2-99.2), classifier 993 (98.4 %), coupled call 995 (98.6 %; 97.2-99.7); the sacrum was anchored on 233 of 290 lateral frames; the stop signal fired on 4 of 5 frames with a coupled error and on 17 of 225 without, and the coupled call was exact on 921 of 922 unflagged bodies (results/COUPLING.md, rows det74/kfull; SchwingNet/sections/results.tex).
Model properties.Degree of automation: Assistive decision support, research use only: names beside the surgeon's own count, abstaining visibly, never replacing the check film. Per body: a box, a level name, a posterior, an abstain or stop flag.
Model properties.Indications for use: Research use only; no clinical indication. The only intraoperative test set is lumbar (C-ArmLSpine), so the tested scope is the lumbar spine and sacrum on a lateral exposure; the anteroposterior view did not transfer to an unseen device.
Model properties.Input: One 8-bit C-arm exposure converted to attenuation and windowed identically for every device (field percentiles 1/5/50/95/99 mapped to 27/47/126/216/239, bone bright; docs/REAL_XRAY_DATASETS_SPEC.md 'Display'); C-ArmLSpine exported at 1,024 x 1,024 (detector pitch 0.293 mm at export, object-plane 0.1915 mm at SID 1140 / SOD 745 mm).
Model properties.Instructions: See docs/MODEL_CARD.md section 8. tools/eval_runtime_cost.py --selftest checks the encoder against ResNet-18 arithmetic; tools/claims_check.py re-derives every manuscript number from its result file and exits non-zero on drift; tools/or_audit_splits.py and tools/or_audit_dupes.py run the leakage audit. No packaged inference entry point exists outside tools/level_prototype.py.
Model properties.Limitations: (1) Detection on an unseen device is the binding constraint: 231 of 287 vertebrae (80.5 %; 74.1-86.8) and 43 of 56 sacra (76.8 %; 64.3-89.3) at 0.74 (results/a1.json), short of the 97 % counting grade stated beforehand; at the software default 0.25, 260 of 287 (90.6 %) and 47 of 56 (83.9 %). Boxes are whole-vertebra projections; the vertebral-body convention recompute is pending (G5). (2) The anteroposterior view did not transfer zero-shot: 239 of 631 (37.9 %; 29.6-45.9). (3) Truth is two automatic labellers (TotalSegmentator, SPINEPS with VERIDAH) agreeing on 814 of 910 CBCT vertebrae; the filter withholds T11 and most of T12, and both count from the sacrum, so agreement is not independent; no person read an intraoperative image. (4) Whether the 148 C-ArmLSpine cases are 148 people cannot be established; case-grouped 606 of 617 (98.2 %; Wilson on the design-effect-adjusted n 94.6-99.4; percentile 95.7-100.0; BCa 95.0-99.5; 141 cases, 3 with an error) against day-grouped 571 of 617 (92.5 %; 87.7-96.4; BCa 87.0-96.1), a gap not explained. (5) Transitional evidence is thin: the L6-L5 silhouette 0.35 (0.31-0.39; 98 crops, 10 persons) is on the validation split that chose the checkpoint; the three never-seen L6 patients separate only under the whole-vertebra box; 49 of the 54 L6 validation and test persons of the built split were in the current encoder's training (tables/tab4_transitional.md), so no model reported here scores the transitional test persons; the 3 real transitional persons in public releases (the C-ArmLSpine L6) are scored only in cross-validation as agreement with one labeller's read; certifying 90 % exact-level accuracy needs 35 error-free at-risk persons, and 7 real-frame candidates exist, 0 of them verified (packet_src/persons_available_2026-09-24.json, the persons-available block of results/power/power.json as of 2026-09-24). (6) The comparison with registration-assisted labelling (LevelCheck) and surgeons using it is a separate study (paper 2, SchwingNet/paper2_levelcheck/; its comparator LEVELCHECK_MODEL.md is frozen, last commit d0403de) and nothing from it is quoted in this card. (7) The per-device image-formation terms missed their pre-stated every-device criterion (results/a6.json; statistical review F6). (8) The posterior is uncalibrated. (9) VinDr-SpineXR crops in the fold banks were obtained under a PhysioNet data use agreement outside the project's IRB determination (open). (10) Untested: cervical and thoracic intraoperative frames, instrumentation, paediatric, post-operative and deformed spines, any C-arm beyond those named. (11) Nothing evaluated prospectively. (12) The plain-film naming figures of the level bank (CSXA, BUU-LSPINE, NHANES II) were scored on the split that selected the encoder's checkpoint and are not quoted as held-out performance (results/eval_gate/EVALUATORS.md item 1). (13) Only the sacrum detector's held-out-device results are clean; its checkpoint was selected on the COBRA2026 and DeepFluoro test frames, and its render-trained parent trained on renders of five, and validated on renders of one, of the 17 subjects of the synthetic arc set (results/eval_gate/EVALUATORS.md).

Output.Description: Per detected body: a box, a level name from 27 classes (C1-C7, T1-T13, L1-L6, sacrum), its posterior, an abstain flag; per frame: the ranks from the detected sacrum, the chosen naming alphabet and a stop flag when classifier and coupled call disagree. No CDE is mapped.

Model properties.Recommendation: Do not use clinically. Quote every figure with its clustered interval, its operating point and its result file; report detection beside naming and the abstention and stop rates beside every accuracy; for transitional spines quote nothing beyond the three C-ArmLSpine patients' cross-validation agreement with one labeller's read and the person counts of Table 2 and Figure 5; the comparison with LevelCheck is paper 2's and is quoted from there when it is unblinded. Never quote a selection-split number as held-out performance.

Regulatory information.Authorization status: Not submitted to any regulator; research prototype
Regulatory information.Comment: The author has a commercial interest in a level-confirmation product under development; no product or regulatory pathway is named in this work (the conflict statement of the full title page).

Model properties.Reproducibility: Every manuscript number is listed with its result file and JSON path in SchwingNet/NUMBERS.md; the rigor-audit intervals are recomputed by tools/rigor_fixes.py and SchwingNet/tools/stats_review_recompute.py. Seeds: sacrum detector 0 (args.yaml). Missing: code SHA in the level-model result files, SHA-256 for the fold weights (the split-trained arm's manifest is paper 2's). The sacrum detector's checkpoint was selected on its training devices' test splits, so only its held-out-device numbers are clean. What each scored checkpoint and its ancestors trained and selected on, per patient key: SchwingNet/results/eval_gate/LINEAGE.md and EVALUATORS.md (306 checkpoints; tools/eval_gate.py refuses a held-out claim on a touched person).
Model properties.Sustainability: Compute was on the Wayne State grid (partitions reqp for CPU, gvohp/galhp for GPU). Encoder 11.2 M parameters, head 2.1 M parameters, detector YOLO11m; a run-level energy or GPU-hour total has not been derived (docs/MODEL_CARD.md section 6.6).

EHR compatibility.Other: None. Standalone research code; no EHR, PACS or C-arm integration exists.

Procedures.Name: Intraoperative lumbar spine C-arm fluoroscopy, lateral and anteroposterior exposures

Imaging.Resolution: 1024 x 1024 px exposures. C-ArmLSpine: 0.15 mm detector pitch at 2048 native (header PixelSpacing is a 1.0 placeholder), exported at 1024 with px_mm_detector 0.2930 and object-plane px_mm 0.1915. COBRA Elekta XVI: 504 x 504 at 0.8 mm. DeepFluoro Cios Fusion: 1536 x 1536 at 0.194 mm. Geneva BV Pulsera: 1000 x 1000 at 0.2904 mm.
Imaging.Comments: The RadLex RID for fluoroscopy was recalled from memory and not verified against the RadLex server in this session; see VALIDATION.md. Input PNGs are derived from DICOM (C-ArmLSpine, DeepFluoro vendor), HDF5 (DeepFluoro registered frames), MHA (COBRA) and NPZ (Geneva) sources through tools/realxray_*_export.py, hence 'Other'.

Model performance.Comments: Intervals are 2,000-resample bootstraps clustered by case (percentile, BCa beside), or Wilson on the design-effect-adjusted count where errors fall in few clusters (SchwingNet/NUMBERS.md). NAMING on C-ArmLSpine, detected lateral bodies at full coverage: zero-shot (no C-ArmLSpine frame in training) 594 of 617 (96.3 %; Wilson on the design-effect-adjusted n 92.0-98.3; 141 cases) (results/a7.json); anteroposterior 239 of 631 (37.9 %; 29.6-45.9). Fine-tuned, case-grouped five-fold: 606 of 617 (98.2 %; Wilson on the design-effect-adjusted n 94.6-99.4; percentile 95.7-100.0; BCa 95.0-99.5; 141 cases, 3 with an error) (results/a4.json); anteroposterior 610 of 631 (96.7 %; 93.6-99.1); day-grouped three-fold 571 of 617 (92.5 %; 87.7-96.4; BCa 87.0-96.1) (results/a9.json). Limited fields, case-grouped: five bodies 647 of 667 (97.0 %; 93.3-99.8), three 1,079 of 1,162 (92.9 %; 89.6-95.6), one 440 of 604 (72.8 %; 69.0-76.2) (results/a4.json). COUNT AND COUPLING at sacrum-detector confidence 0.74: count from the detected sacrum exact on 979 of 1,009 anchored bodies of 130 cases (97.0 %; 94.2-99.2), classifier 993 (98.4 %), coupled call 995 (98.6 %; 97.2-99.7); the sacrum was anchored on 233 of 290 lateral frames; the stop signal fired on 4 of 5 frames with a coupled error and on 17 of 225 without, and the coupled call was exact on 921 of 922 unflagged bodies (results/COUPLING.md, rows det74/kfull; SchwingNet/sections/results.tex). DETECTION, device held out (trained on COBRA2026 and DeepFluoro real frames; 56 C-ArmLSpine test frames, 28 cases, IoU 0.5, whole-vertebra boxes): 231 of 287 vertebrae (80.5 %; 74.1-86.8), 43 of 56 sacra (76.8 %; 64.3-89.3) at 0.74 (results/a1.json). EMBEDDING (allspine_v9, validation split that chose the checkpoint): nearest crop of another person at the same level for 74.9 % (72.2-77.6) of 13,009 validation crops of 1,612 persons; cosine silhouette L6 against L5 0.35 (0.31-0.39; 98 crops, 10 persons), L5 against L4 0.23 (0.21-0.25; 721 persons) (results/figure2/figure2_metrics.json). TRANSITIONAL: no held-out transitional person is scored; the three C-ArmLSpine patients one labeller reads as L6 are scored in cross-validation as agreement with that read (the coupled call agreed on one of their four anchored frames at confidence 0.74; SchwingNet/sections/results.tex). The comparison against a LevelCheck model is paper 2's (SchwingNet/paper2_levelcheck/); nothing from it is quoted. NOT QUOTED: The plain-film naming figures of the level bank (CSXA, BUU-LSPINE, NHANES II) were scored on the split that selected the encoder's checkpoint and are not quoted as held-out performance (results/eval_gate/EVALUATORS.md item 1). Not measured: calibration, per-class intervals, training-partition performance.
